findings.test: Consent denial persistence and gate journeys
findings.evidence: Executed 22 screen suites successfully. Updated consent behavior assertions use the real consent store and assert the versioned accepted state/persistence and denied navigation behavior. Isolated mutations for blocked persistence/redirect and blocked UI both failed (12 tests each).
findings.changes: Retained real consent state and explicit denial/version persistence expectations.
findings.remaining_risk: Native permission prompt behavior remains outside Jest; permission outcomes are boundary mocks.

findings.test: Home photo source gate and entry action flows
findings.evidence: Executed screen suite with real photo store. Isolated remove/clear source mutations each failed 1 assertion; source-gate mutation failed 2; button-column no-op failed 2; wrong destination failed 2. This confirms store clearing and rendered button wiring are observed.
findings.changes: Use real photo store state and awaited user interactions to check removal/reset and entry actions.
findings.remaining_risk: Home screen native photo picking is mocked at the platform boundary.

findings.test: IntroFlowScreen shows each slide, returns with Previous, and advances to /consent
findings.evidence: Journey test passed in full screen suite, asserting visible slide content at each step including after Previous. The isolated no-op Previous mutation failed 1 test and forward-navigation mutation failed 3.
findings.changes: Assert rendered step content through Previous and forward navigation using userEvent.

findings.evidence: Flow tests exercise the real submission store with native map boundary mocked. Confirmed map movement writes the moved coordinates as a pin, and cancel preserves original location. Isolated no-pin and move-does-not-commit mutations failed (1 and 2 assertions); no-confirm-write and no-cancel-back probes also failed.
findings.changes: Use real Submission store and move/cancel/set journeys with persisted draft assertions.
findings.remaining_risk: Expo Maps native rendering and camera gesture delivery are represented by a narrow mock.

findings.test: Cat List actions and Cat List with no cats left (#299)
findings.evidence: Tests use real submission/UI stores with AlertHost; selected delete removes only the selected cat after confirmation, and Finished is disabled at zero cats. Isolated wrong-id delete and zero-cat-enabled mutations each failed 1 assertion. Additional action wiring probes failed for no actions/no accordion.
findings.changes: Exercise real store state, await confirmation UI actions, and assert selected deletion and disabled empty-state submit.

findings.evidence: ESLint completed successfully against the screen test files.

summary: All 22 screen test suites (102 tests) pass; scoped ESLint passes. Updated screen tests kill all replayed previously surviving screen and submission probes in isolated snapshots.
